text:
maya: kicking off a short canary for model v9 tomorrow morning. plan is percent-based in NA first, then EU. quick checklist: feature flag name, kill-switch, dashboards to watch, smoke tests?

liam: proposed ramp: 0.5% -> 5% after 30m -> 20% after 2h, then evaluate for full roll. hope to keep NA at least 1h at 5% before EU.

sasha: agree. region order: us-east, us-west, eu-west. keep apac blocked until we validate latency metrics.

jen-oncall: can we hard-wire a kill-switch route? if error_rate > 1% for 3m or p95 latency spikes > 300ms, auto-disable flag. also add a slack alert to #incidents + pager.

ops-bot: Actionable snippet for toggle tool:
```
# set percent and regions via rctl
rctl feature set models.v9.canary --percent 0.5 --regions us-east
# increase to 5%
rctl feature set models.v9.canary --percent 5 --regions us-east,us-west
# disable
rctl feature set models.v9.canary --disable
```

liam: note: UI toggle exists but use rctl for scripted ramp so we have CLI audit logs. i'll run the steps and post confirmations.

maya: who's owning monitoring during the first 2 hours? need someone to watch errors, hallucination signal, token-cost regression.

liam: i'll monitor for the first hour and hand off to sasha for EU ramp.

sasha: will add a dashboard tile for model_v9_quality and a quick alert if novelty_score drops > 5%.

maya: preflight checklist:
- smoke tests: @liam to run smoke-suite on stagings with model v9 (small prompt set)
- canary guardrail config added to /runbooks/model-rollouts.md (link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-rollouts)
- inform support and product for customer-impact watch

liam: smoke-suite run started (link: https://ci.redwood/runs/12345) — all green except one low-confidence prompt, logged.

jen-oncall: please add this to oncall rotation notes: if we get > 0.8% 5xx across the canary slice escalate to oncall immediately.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary start at 2025-06-02T15:00Z by liam.

deploy-bot: Rollout Scheduled: models.v9.canary at 2025-06-02T15:00Z (owner: liam). Use rctl logs to follow: `rctl logs --feature models.v9.canary --follow`.

maya: tiny ask for the rollout message: include the expected traffic counts for 0.5% in NA so support has context.

liam: 0.5% ~ 120 req/min across NA slice (estimate). posting to #support now.

sasha: quick CR ping — i left a small change to the guardrail YAML in https://git.internal/redwood/flag-configs MR #788. can someone review? it's the auto-rollback rule and alert channels.

maya: doing a quick pass now.

liam: reviewed and approved. :thumbsup:

maya: final: i'll start the canary doc in the release tracker and tag everyone. liam will run the ramp, sasha will own EU handoff, jen-oncall owns pager rules. call out if anything missing. :rocket:
